extracted.intended_audience: aspiring authors and literary agents submitting manuscripts to Hachette India (India)
extracted.subtask_description: Publisher submission guidelines for Hachette India covering adult/business books (via literary agent) and children's & reference books (direct submissions). Lists required materials, file formats, language, response times, and legal/disclaimer notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unsolicited submissions policy
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not accept any unsolicited material. We only accept submissions sent to us via a literary agent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hachette India takes no responsibility for proposals sent directly to us. Emails about unsolicited work will not be responded to.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agent requirement for adult/business books
rubrics_metrics.description: Writers may submit a manuscript via any established literary agent, provided the agent is registered as a literary agency business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The list given on the page is indicative and not exhaustive. Hachette India does not recommend or endorse any particular agency, and listing does not mean they will accept a submission made through an agent. Writers engage agents at their own volition and risk; Hachette India shall not be liable for commitments, transactions or disagreements between writers and the literary agents they have opted for.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct submissions for children’s and reference books
rubrics_metrics.description: We do accept direct submissions in this segment. Please send your manuscripts for children's books, and reference (all ages) titles only to crsubmissions@hachetteindia.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This email ID is only for children's and reference book submissions. Please do not send any adult book to this email ID. They will not be responded to.

rubrics_metrics.name: One-page proposal requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: ONE-PAGE proposal that outlines the plot/structure of the book, introduces the characters, and profiles the target readership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is to ensure a quick reply; include concise outline, character introductions and target readership profile in a single page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter break-up (where applicable)
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter break-up, wherever applicable, such as in non-fiction and reference books.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a chapter-by-chapter breakdown for non-fiction and reference titles to demonstrate structure and scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sample chapters required
rubrics_metrics.description: First three sample chapters to help us get an idea of your writing style.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the opening three chapters so editors can assess narrative voice, pacing, and craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artwork samples (if applicable)
rubrics_metrics.description: Three samples of artwork if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide representative artwork samples for illustrated children's books or books where art is central.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author bio length
rubrics_metrics.description: A short author bio, no more than 200 words.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the bio concise and relevant — maximum 200 words.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting: typed, legible font and size
rubrics_metrics.description: All submissions should be typed up using legible font, using 12 pt size or above.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure readability by using standard fonts and at least 12 pt size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incomplete or non-compliant submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Incomplete submissions not keeping to the guidelines above will not be considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to include required elements or follow formatting/file rules may lead to automatic rejection or non-consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preferred file formats and delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: We prefer soft copy submissions (.doc or .pdf) and discourage you from sending printed manuscripts by post.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Jpgs and other image files of separate pages are not acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: We only accept submissions in English. Translations into English are welcome.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit manuscripts in English; if your work is in another language, provide an English translation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgement and decision timeframe
rubrics_metrics.description: Email submissions will receive an immediate automated acknowledgment, and a decision from us indicatively within eight weeks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should expect an automated receipt and an indicative decision timeline of up to eight weeks for submissions to the children's/reference inbox.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requesting full manuscript or revisions is not a commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: Calling for a full manuscript or asking for revisions do not constitute a commitment to publish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors' requests for more material are part of evaluation and do not guarantee an offer.

rubrics_metrics.name: No feedback on rejected manuscripts
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that we do not provide feedback or suggestions on how to improve manuscripts we have rejected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should not expect editorial notes or critique when a submission is declined.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agent list disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: The list given below is an indicative list of agents available with us and is not meant to be either an updated or an all-encompassing list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The listing below does not mean that Hachette India is undertaking to accept a book submission made through an agent. Hachette India does not recommend or endorse any particular agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope note for adult/business translations
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission category includes general fiction, non-fiction and translations for Adult and Business Books.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translations for adult/business titles are included in the category but must follow the agent-based submission policy (i.e., via a literary agent).
